purpose: Optional high-resolution terrain: the park at the source data's native 10 m, as a residual over heightfield.json's 20.5 m grid. Downloaded only when the quality control asks for it.
rowOrientation: row 0 = north edge (ymax); row N-1 = south edge (ymin)

encoding.meaning: a signed elevation CORRECTION in metres, to be ADDED to the bilinear value of heightfield.json at the same world point
encoding.zeroOutsideBbox: The correction is zero everywhere outside bboxCrsUnits, and is faded to exactly zero over the outermost pixels, so the tier adds detail without moving the surface at its edge.
